messages.author: e5c7e56038437512
messages.subject: Frechet distribution
parts:
Hi!

I would like to model a parameter with Frechet density function. For the above, I'm considering the following: 
If Y ~ Frechet(alpha, sigma), then Y^-1 ~ Weibull (alpha, sigma^-1) (https://mc-stan.org/docs/2_18/functions-reference/frechet-distribution.html)

So in TMB:

PARAMETER(y);
PARAMETER(alpha);
PARAMETER(sigma);

// Transformed parameters
y_inv = pow(y, -1);
sigma_inv =  pow(sigma, -1);  ;

nll -= dweibull(y_inv,  alpha,    sigma_inv,  true);   

// Jacobian in y
nll -= y; 

Thank you in advance. 
Cheers,

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: Frechet distribution
parts:
Hi jcavieres,

At first sight it seemed to me that you have already solved your own problem. But perhaps you are asking for someone to double check?
I think the line:

Should be replaced by (I think)

// Jacobian  dyinv/dy=1/y^2 so negative log correction is
nll += 2*log(y);

Cheers,
Kasper
